title: Z9.F shift degree — Exact coefficient of the genuine polynomial difference
milestone_description: For every natural $n$ and nonzero rational polynomial $H$ of natural degree $d$, the coefficient of $X^{d+10}$ in the actual $D_n(H)$ equals $(7n-2-d)\operatorname{LC}(H)$. This identity needs only $H\ne0$; no positivity, parity, degree-gap, monicity or preassigned operator relation is assumed. The degree-$d+11$ terms cancel in the actual polynomial calculation.
